title: Merz Backs Ilse Aigner as Germany's First Female President
detail: Chancellor Friedrich Merz has thrown his support behind Ilse Aigner as a candidate for Federal President, which would make her Germany's first woman in the office, according to Times of India reporting on November 9, 2026. Details of the nomination process and other parties' positions were not available in the source.
